data.long_meaning: The meaning of Noach is recorded in name-lists as “Rest, Comfort, Consolation”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Noach expresses “Rest, Comfort, Consolation”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noach total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: נוח
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew verb 'anah' which means to 'comfort' or ' Console'. The name Noach is given to the man who built an ark to save his family and the animals from the Great Flood.

in_greek.name: Νοε
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'noeo' which means 'to rest' or 'to be at ease'. In the New Testament, the name Noe is used in reference to Noah.

in_latin.name: Noah
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Noah is derived from the Hebrew name Noach. The name Noah is given to the man who built an ark to save his family and the animals from the Great Flood.
